_comment: Test kit mailed to Stompa before every test (Messenger > Commando, via SPT's 'spt give'). Stompa loses the kit in each test raid, so every new kitId mails the whole kit; F4 in the menus resends it. Ghost/lab tests: lean (only what the test needs, presets with their magazine + one magazine of ammo). Normal raids without ghost (Stompa, 2026-10-16): a full META-style kit with plenty of magazines and ammo + the meds a raid needs. 'spt give' sends a template with a default preset as the whole preset (weapons with their magazine, armour with its plates); magazines and meds come one per count, ammo split into stacks. Template ids verified in the SPT 4.1.6 database (2026-10-16).
note: Final raid before release (1.0.0 public build, shotgun, ghost off): Saiga-12K full-auto + 5 drums (20 rounds each) + 60 8.5 mm Magnum buckshot, 30 flechette, 20 AP-20 slugs; 6B43 Zabralo-Sh class 6, 6B47 + WMX200, ComTac II, 3 M67, raid meds, rig, backpack. The public build has no mailer: type the spt give lines in Commando.
